name: vm-toolkit
description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Throwaway VMs of a product's target OS (Windows on QEMU, macOS on tart), driven from a Mac: golden image and layers, per-run copy-on-write clones sharing a worktree, build and test in the guest, app launch, screenshots and input (with highlighted regions), demo videos with captions, highlights and a narrating voice (Kokoro, offline), checkpoints (a sign-in or setup kept for the next VMs), a cleanup dashboard, the screen in TigerVNC (shared clipboard) or Screen Sharing. A skill and an MCP server, for any agent
